decisions.reason: The GA4 tracking plugin builds directly on the firm's plugin development and analytics expertise, and it serves the current Google standard, so demand will continue as merchants migrate.
Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in 2023-2024, so the plugin loses its purpose and the firm can move that knowledge and those resources into GA4 work.
The retail system interface plugin relies on the firm's core interface development skills and supports its integration services, making it easy to maintain and improve.
Relaunch SEO support combines the firm's established relaunch project experience with its search marketing know-how, has its own page, and fits its full-service offering.
